zh: 任何先非递减后非递增的区间都有一个峰顶；以峰顶为界，左边是以峰顶结尾的非递减段，右边是从峰顶开始的非递增段。
预处理up[i]（以i结尾的最长非递减连续段长度）和down[i]（从i开始的最长非递增连续段长度），以i为峰顶的最长合法区间长度就是up[i]+down[i]−1。
从左到右：a[i]≥a[i−1]时up[i]=up[i−1]+1，否则为1；从右到左：a[i]≥a[i+1]时down[i]=down[i+1]+1，否则为1。答案是所有位置up[i]+down[i]−1的最大值。
en: Every interval that first does not decrease and then does not increase has a peak; to the left of the peak is a non-decreasing part ending at the peak, and to the right is a non-increasing part starting at it.

Precompute up[i], the longest non-decreasing contiguous run ending at i, and down[i], the longest non-increasing contiguous run starting at i; the longest valid interval with peak i has length up[i]+down[i]−1.
Left to right: up[i]=up[i−1]+1 when a[i]≥a[i−1], otherwise 1; right to left: down[i]=down[i+1]+1 when a[i]≥a[i+1], otherwise 1. The answer is the maximum of up[i]+down[i]−1 over all positions.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute the non-decreasing length ending at each position and the non-increasing length starting at each position, then enumerate the peak, add the two and subtract one.

## Proof of correctness

Every valid interval has a peak, and its two sides are bounded by these two maximal lengths at that position. Conversely, joining the two maximal runs at the peak still gives a valid interval, so the maximum of the enumerated values is exactly optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
